Programs

Straight from the center's own class list — no invented programs.

🤸 Children's Gymnastics

Classes for all ages, Tue–Sat. Build strength, balance, confidence and coordination — one class a week or up to four.

From $65/mo

✨ Performing Class

A special Friday 7–8 PM class for children ready to perform — part of LAC's competitive & performance team tradition.

Fridays 7:00–8:00 PM

💪 Adult / Young Adult Gymnastics

The Friday-night favorite: beginners welcome, tumbling & acrobatics, 8:00–9:30 PM. Just show up and tumble.

$25 / class

🎯 Private 1-on-1 Training

One-on-one coaching for faster progress on a specific skill, routine, or goal.

📣 Stunt / Cheerleading Clinics

Special workshops and clinics for stunt and cheer skills — ask about upcoming dates.

🎉 Parties & Events

Exclusive parties, events and special performances hosted at the center. Call to plan yours.
